bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
live="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-inline-query-1b571f)" || exit 63
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-4a1c5be3)" || exit 64
tagid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" || exit 65
if test "$live" = "$newid"; then echo CURRENT_LIVE=INLINE_QUERY_CANDIDATE; elif test "$live" = "$oldid"; then echo CURRENT_LIVE=PREVIOUS_LINK; else exit 66; fi
test "$live" = "$tagid" || exit 67
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
if docker logs --since 30m --tail 500 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then echo BOT_READY_LOG=YES; else echo BOT_READY_LOG=NO; exit 69; fi
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -lc 'grep -Fq "inline_query" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 70
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=PASS
echo INLINE_HANDLER_BUNDLE_PRESENT=PASS
